lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Bonne Bouche.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Apparently we're going to be working together.
Yes, so I hear.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Now I don't have to worry about following you around

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: and taking time out of our busy schedule

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: to make plans with you.
I don't think either of those things ever concerned you before.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Hehe, well, to be honest,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I was worried about what Crust would think.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I usually can't leave my post when I'm needed,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: but now that I'm working with you,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I've got the perfect excuse!
You consider us working together an excuse?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I desperately want to taste you again, Bonne Bouche.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: In fact,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I'm a bit hungry at the moment.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Where are you, hehe?
Not now.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Are you busy?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I want to lick your hand.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Can't I?
You did precisely that for two days straight.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: If I lick your hands today, that'll make it three.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Good.
My hands need some rest.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Aren't they resting right now?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: It's not like I'm licking them all day.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Of course, I'd love nothing more than that,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: but I feel like my stomach might burst if I did.
Don't you have any consideration for my hands in all this?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Your hands are so precious to me, Bonne Bouche.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I'm always worried about what I'll do

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: if the taste suddenly changes.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: What if, one day, your hands taste entirely different?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Actually, that could be kinda fun.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Bonne Bouche.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: So is today really a no go?
Fine, sounds like I don't have much of a choice. You can go ahead.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Woohoo!

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I'll leave right away.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Wait for me just a few minutes.
